layout.automated: This is an automated email, please do not reply.

verify_email.subject: Verify your email address
verify_email.title: Verify your email address
verify_email.intro: Please confirm your email address to activate your {app} account.
verify_email.footnote: If you did not create an account, you can safely ignore this email.

email_change.subject: Confirm your new email address
email_change.title: Confirm your new email address
email_change.intro: We received a request to change the email address of your {app} account to {email}.
email_change.footnote: If you did not request the change, you can safely ignore this email.

reset_password.subject: Reset your password
reset_password.title: Choose a new password
reset_password.intro: We received a request to reset the password of your {app} account.
reset_password.footnote: If you did not request a new password, you can safely ignore this email.

password_changed.subject: Your password was changed
password_changed.title: Your password was changed
password_changed.intro: The password of your {app} account was changed and the other sessions were closed.
password_changed.footnote: If this was not you, reset your password right away and contact the support.

organization_invitation.subject: {inviter} invited you to {organization}
organization_invitation.title: Join {organization}
organization_invitation.footnote: If you were not expecting this invitation, you can safely ignore this email.

welcome.subject: Welcome to {app}
welcome.title: Welcome to {app}
welcome.intro: Your {app} account is ready. These are the next steps to get the most out of it.
welcome.footnote: You can change the language and the appearance of the product from your profile.

subscription_started.subject: Your {plan} subscription started
subscription_started.title: Your {plan} plan is active
subscription_started.intro: The payment of your {app} subscription was accepted and the plan is already active.
subscription_started.footnote: The subscription renews automatically until you cancel it.

payment_failed.subject: The payment of your subscription failed
payment_failed.title: We could not charge your payment method
payment_failed.intro: The last payment of your {app} subscription could not be charged.
payment_failed.footnote: We retry the payment during the next 7 days. Update the payment method to keep the plan.

subscription_canceled.subject: Your subscription was canceled
subscription_canceled.title: Your subscription was canceled
subscription_canceled.intro: The subscription of your {app} account was canceled and the plan is no longer active.
subscription_canceled.footnote: You can start a new subscription at any moment.

quota.warning_subject: You have used {percent}% of your {scope} quota
quota.exceeded_subject: You have used all your {scope} credits
quota.warning_title: You are close to the limit of your {scope} quota
quota.exceeded_title: You have used all your {scope} credits
quota.body: Your organization has used {used} of {limit} {scope} credits of the current period.
quota.footnote: The quota is renewed at the beginning of every billing period.
